text: つよいな　びっくり　したぜ

patterns.name: 〜な
patterns.explanation: な at the end shows the speaker's own feeling, here being impressed. つよいな = 'wow, you're strong'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, manly way to push a statement at the listener. びっくり したぜ = 'I was surprised, man'.
